# SUI-23 — Standardise far-right Output and Gain Reduction meters across every plugin

**Tracking issue:** https://github.com/tonygward/audio-plugins/issues/320
**Origin:** Generated by Matrix from the tracking issue when the card was picked up, because no prompt file existed and the issue had enough detail. The issue text below is the specification.

## Objective
Make the **Songsmith Compressor** the definitive visual/layout reference for right-hand metering **across every Songsmith audio plugin**. Every plugin must have a visible output-level meter at the **far right edge** of its editor. Every plugin that performs compression/dynamics gain reduction must also show the standard **Gain Reduction** meter beside its output meter. In particular, **relocate the Maximiser's existing Gain Reduction and Output meters to the far right**, using the same arrangement and visual conventions as Songsmith Compressor.

## Owner direction (18 November 2026)
- "Each plugin should have the level meter present to the right (like Songsmith Compressor - that's the gold standard)."
- "If it's a compressor there must also be the standard Gain reduction option."
- "Even the Maximier Gain Reduction & Output must be moved to the far right and made consistent with the Compressor."

This **supersedes SUI-22 #307's earlier choice of Maximiser as the layout reference**. Retain shared tubular visual style from SUI-22, but **Songsmith Compressor determines meter grouping, location, scale/readability and UI hierarchy**.

## Scope
- Audit **all current plugins** including Songsmith EQ, Songsmith Compressor, Analog Compressor, Maximiser, Optical Leveller, Passive EQ and Bus Compressor, plus any additional shipping plugin processors; do not silently omit newer plugins.
- Add or relocate a clearly labelled real-time **Output** level meter to the far right in *every* plugin. Preserve existing stereo L/R where relevant, peak, clip/latch and calibrated units.
- Dynamics processors (**Compressor, Analog Compressor, Bus Compressor, Optical Leveller, Maximiser**) must have an adjacent, clearly labelled **Gain Reduction** meter using the Songsmith Compressor convention. Include other dynamics plugins if present. Non-dynamics EQ plugins need output metering, **not fake gain reduction**.
- **Maximiser specifically:** move its current Gain Reduction and Output meter group to the far-right border, adjacent and consistent in placement, height, rendering, spacing, scale and typography with Songsmith Compressor. Preserve the LUFS/integrated loudness monitoring and any other distinct informative readings; do not conflate loudness with output peak level.
- Use a **single consistent right-hand meter column** (or the same layout pattern as Compressor) for the whole suite. Adapt for resizing and HiDPI while maintaining a clear visual separation from knobs, sliders, graphs, and footer/control rows.
- Preserve plugin-specific themes/faceplate colours while keeping the shared meter language identical. Reuse common meter widgets rather than cloning each implementation. Respect ongoing ACOMP-21 and prior PEQ-03/SUI-22 work; avoid regressing those.
- Display real measured post-processing output and real reduction; correct bypass/no-reduction behaviour, no fictional reduction. Do not alter DSP, saved presets, parameter IDs, automation or audio processing solely to move UI components.

## Acceptance criteria
1. Side-by-side screenshots at normal and small supported sizes show all installed audio plugins with a **far-right Output** meter matching Songsmith Compressor's meter geometry/spacing/hierarchy.
2. Compressor, Analog Compressor, Bus Compressor, Optical Leveller and Maximiser show distinct, legible **Gain Reduction + Output** meters at the far right. Clean/passive EQ show Output only. Verify the actual complete plugin inventory before declaring coverage.
3. Maximiser no longer has its Gain Reduction/Output meters embedded elsewhere: both are grouped at the **far right**, visibly matching Compressor.
4. Consistent meter direction, red gain-reduction convention, units, stereo labelling, peaks, clipping indication, ballistic response and accessibility/tooltips as applicable. Metering remains correct under silence, real compression, bypass and resize.
5. No controls obstruct/overlap the meter column; existing options and graph features survive.
6. All affected plugins build/test on supported targets; automated UI/measurement tests as feasible. Include before/after screenshots and list the plugins inspected/changed in PR.
7. Follow existing Songsmith execution policy: green required CI, merged PR, release/build and beta website publication verified before marking Done; report any deployment or installer verification gaps rather than claiming them.
